name: Bonggo
sweep_summary: Bonggo is not in the catalog and the sweep's single item is a Glottolog false hit: Karsono's KIMLI 2011 paper 'Pola Unsur Suprasegmental Nada Bahasa Tionghoa Orang Surabaya' was auto-assigned to Bonggo [bpg] from the Indonesian word 'pola' (Glottolog's own lgcode note says 'computerized assignment from \"pola\"'); the open PDF (Petra repository, read in full, saved) is a Praat study of Mandarin Chinese lexical tone and sentence intonation as produced by non-Chinese-speaking Surabaya residents. It says nothing about Bonggo or about word stress. Glottolog's reference list for bong1287 (18 entries, saved) holds no grammar or phonology: all Bonggo-specific items are wordlists/ethnography (Grace 1956 fieldnotes, Grace 1971/1972 Sarmi-coast comparative phonology notes in Irian 1(3), Kim 2006 SIL survey report on Bgu/Kaptiau/Tarpia, 1960s Bgu kinship papers). Attempts to reach Kim 2006 on sil.org returned HTTP 403; ScholarSpace and Wikipedia gave nothing; No first-hand statement of Bonggo word stress was found. If anyone pursues one, the Kim 2006 SIL Electronic Survey Report (47 pp., 'overview;wordlist;socling') and Grace's 1955-56 Bonggo notebook are the only candidates, both low expected yield (medium priority for Kim 2006, print/archive-only for Grace). Everything fetched sources is under with.

earlier_scan.source_named: Only wordlists/surveys exist (Grace 1956 fieldnotes; Anceaux wordlists; Kim 2006 survey); no grammar or phonology of Bonggo located
